integrity: The result uses a complete proof of the universal statement and a separately executable finite checker. Literature searches cannot rule out unindexed equivalent work. No external or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns standard odd cyclic tournaments, filtration degrees one and two, and the first-stage homotopy and symmetry lattice only. Higher-degree persistence and the stage-two homotopy type are not classified. The symmetric reflections act on the abstract simplex-set filtration, not as arc-preserving automorphisms. Finite checks do not establish the general theorem.
title: The first two 3-cycle filtration stages of odd cyclic tournaments
